text:
Alex: Heads-up: PR #8214 ready to merge but gated on arch RFC — need arch signoff. RFC: https://redwood.infra/rfcs/148-kv-cache-routing. PR: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/8214. TL;DR: adds prefix/KV caching + fallback routing to cheaper model variants under congestion. Can someone from Arch own the RFC review? cc @Maya @Ben
Maya: Looking now, thanks. Quick q — do we have latency tail numbers post-change or just avg?
Alex: Perf section in the PR has the benchmark link: ./bench/kv_cache_tail.md and CI artifact https://ci.redwood/1234. 95th drops from ~420ms to ~360ms with batching. Flagged a kv invalidation race in one edge test.
Ben: Noted. My concern is fallback routing returning different model variants — we need deterministic tokenization/accounting for embedding consumers. Can we add a compatibility test? If not present, we should hold merge.
Priya: Who owns the RFC today? The doc lists authors but no explicit owner label. We should get an owner or arch approver before merging. @Alex can you nominate someone? If not, I'll assign to eng-ml for review.
Alex: I nominate Maya to own arch signoff — she helped design the cache. @Maya okay to own?
Maya: :thumbsup: I can own the review. I'll post inline comments. Also: we need a canary/rollback plan and the exact metric thresholds to unblock.
Alex: Added a canary plan to the PR: start 10% traffic to the dedicated pool for 24h; monitor p99 latency, error rate, and model-quality regressions on our eval set. Rollback if p99 increases >20% or regen-error >0.5%.
Ben: Sounds reasonable. Also please add a short note on token accounting when fallback triggers (how we bill and attribute).
Maya: I'll review and leave comments. Expect blocking vs non-blocking flagged. If CI stays green and token tests added, I can mark LGTM.
deploy-bot: CI: all checks passed for PR #8214 — 15 tests, 0 failures.
Priya: Thanks. Once Maya LGTMs, can we get an explicit arch-stamp comment like: "Arch: Maya - approves RFC 148 for PR #8214" so the merge gate automation can unblock?
Alex: Yep, will add that exact arch-stamp comment after approval.
Maya: Review done. Left two non-blocking nits and one blocking item re: token-accounting tests — see inline. Will flip the blocking once token tests are added.
Alex: Working on the token/accounting tests now, will push within the hour. Thanks everyone.
